title: No No, Wait Wait!
blurb: Consequences outrunning objections by roughly one second. Something irreversible has already begun — the send button pressed, the drop committed to, the sentence spoken aloud in front of the wrong person — and this is the sound of somebody trying to recall it fractionally too late. It is a perfect edit tool for the moment of no return, because the plea and the disaster overlap rather than following one another. Also useful in daily life, more or less continuously, since most of life turns out to be exactly this sound.
origin: A viral too-late panic clip for irreversible moments.
